children: named Balaji Nuthalapadi as interim chief executive officer on Tuesday, days after long-time CEO P N Vasudevan resigned over conflict-of-interest concerns.
The lender said it has begun the process of finding a permanent CEO and would submit its recommendation to the country's central bank.
Last Thursday, Equitas said Vasudevan would resign over a conflict of interest as his daughter runs a non-banking finance company, sending its shares down as much as 20% on that day
Whole-time director Nuthalapadi's appointment is subject to approval from the Reserve Bank of India and will take effect from the date of receipt of the approval
A small finance bank is a lender that provides basic banking and credit services to underserved segments
